5. resource-gate: read container.py's _check_limits and stack_xml.py's incremental walker directly rather than assuming from prior obligation text -- found 7 dimensions already enforced (max_input_bytes, max_entries, max_decompressed_bytes, max_compression_ratio as a genuine zip-bomb detector, max_xml_nodes, max_nesting_depth, max_header_bytes). Checked dumps()/dump() directly and found max_output_bytes was NOT enforced at all -- no limits parameter existed on the write path whatsoever, a real, undisclosed gap, not merely undocumented. Added a limits: ResourceLimits = DEFAULT_LIMITS parameter to both dumps() and dump(), enforced on the final serialized byte length, raising OraLimitError -- matching the exact pattern already used by xliff/ipynb/safetensors/ubl. Added 2 new tests to the existing tests/python/ora/test_obligation_lifecycle_and_write.py (test_dumps_enforces_max_output_bytes, test_dumps_within_max_output_bytes_still_succeeds) rather than a new file, since that file already owns ORA-LIFECYCLE-001/ORA-WRITE-001's own dumps()/dump() coverage.

7. independent-oracle-gate: found oracle/formats/ora/ did not exist at all -- no oracle package anywhere for this format, unlike every other FF6 format. Built oracle-package.yaml from scratch: cited the 3 pinned OpenRaster authority sources (SRC-ORA-001/002/003) already used for this format's own obligation register, used 3 real valid samples and 2 of the 6 real invalid samples already present in samples/by-format/ora/. First attempt used dotted property paths ('document.width') copying xliff's own pattern uncritically -- ran the oracle and got NOT_APPLICABLE for all 3 valid cases. Investigated the executor directly (tools/oracle/execute_oracle.py's own _compare_model_properties, and tools/oracle/enriched_generic.py) and found: (a) the generic single-level getattr(result_val, prop_name) cannot resolve a dotted path at all, and (b) valid-case dispatch for a NEW format requires registration in enriched_generic.py's own ENRICHED_LOADERS dict AND a per-format _enrich_model() branch -- there is no purely-declarative generic path for valid cases the way there is for invalid cases. Registered ora there with a new _enrich_model() branch exposing declared_version, detected_version, width, height, and a newly-written recursive layer_count helper. Re-ran: 5/5 PASS, D1 depth.
